title: Toolbar buttons accept ToolbarButtonProps and can be replaced via componentOverrides
description: Built-in toolbar buttons accept ToolbarButtonProps (document, children, className, onClick) and are exported individually, so customizing one means wrapping it and passing it via componentOverrides.
